content:
### 1) LAYOUT
*   **Window Container:** Centered modal dialog, approx. **[206, 12] to [782, 836]** (576px wide x 824px tall). White background with rounded corners (approx. 8-10px radius).
*   **Header Region:** **[207, 12] to [781, 140]**.
    *   Close button (X): Top-right corner at approx. **[756, 32]** (24x24px area).
    *   Icon: Large blue folder icon centered at top, approx. **[470, 75] to [530, 170]**.
    *   Title Text: Centered below icon.
    *   Subtitle Text: Centered below title.
*   **Tab Bar:** **[247, 265] to [741, 305]**. Two equal-width tabs ("Local", "Cloud") contained in a light gray pill-shaped container.
*   **Drive List Container:** **[247, 322] to [741, 720]**. Light gray background container holding the selectable rows.
    *   **Row 1 (Windows C:):** **[257, 330] to [731, 405]**. Selected state (blue background).
    *   **Warning Banner 1:** **[257, 405] to [731, 465]**. Yellow/Orange background warning box inside Row 1 area.
    *   **Row 2 (Temporary Storage D:):** **[257, 480] to [731, 555]**.
    *   **Row 3 (Choose folder):** **[257, 575] to [731, 630]**.
*   **Footer Region:** **[207, 750] to [781, 836]**.
    *   Left Control: Toggle switch + Label ("Enable file repair").
    *   Right Control: "Save" primary action button.

### 2) TEXT
*   **Window Title (Main):** `Choose a destination path to save the file:` (Location: Center, below icon)
*   **Subtitle:** `You have 1139246 file(s) (146.41 GB) to recover.` (Location: Center, below main title)
*   **Tab 1:** `Local`
*   **Tab 2:** `Cloud`
*   **Row 1 Name:** `Windows (C:)`
*   **Row 1 Stats:** `31.32 GB/149.45 GB` (Color: Red text)
*   **Warning 1 Text:** `We highly recommend saving the found data to a different drive or a network drive.` (Wraps to two lines)
*   **Row 2 Name:** `Temporary Storage (D:)`
*   **Row 2 Stats:** `146.07 GB/150 GB` (Color: Red text)
*   **Row 3 Name:** `Choose folder...`
*   **Footer Toggle Label:** `Enable file repair`
*   **Footer Button:** `Save`

### 3) COLOR
*   **Dialog Background:** `#FFFFFF` (White)
*   **Dialog Overlay/Shadow:** Dark semi-transparent overlay on the main window behind the dialog.
*   **Tab Container Background:** `#F0F0F0` or `#EAEAEA` (Light Gray)
*   **Selected Tab Background:** `#FFFFFF` (White)
*   **List Container Background:** `#F5F7FA` (Very light blue-gray)
*   **Selected Row Background:** `#E6F0FF` (Light Blue)
*   **Primary Button Background:** `#1677FF` (Standard Windows/Fluent Blue)
*   **Primary Button Text:** `#FFFFFF` (White)
*   **Toggle Switch (Active):** `#1677FF` (Blue track), White knob.
*   **Text Primary (Title):** `#1F1F1F` (Near Black)
*   **Text Secondary (Subtitle/Stats):** `#666666` or `#555555` (Dark Gray)
*   **Text Warning/Alert (Stats):** `#D93025` or `#FF3333` (Red)
*   **Warning Banner Background:** `#FFF7E6` (Pale Orange/Yellow)
*   **Warning Icon Color:** `#FAAD14` (Amber/Orange) for D:, `#FF4D4F` (Red) for C:
*   **Border Lines (Tabs/List):** `#D9D9D9` (Light Gray)

### 4) TYPOGRAPHY
*   **Main Title:** Approx. **16px - 18px**, Weight **Medium/Semi-Bold (600)**. Sans-serif (Segoe UI / System UI).
*   **Subtitle:** Approx. **13px - 14px**, Weight **Regular (400)**. Color Gray.
*   **Tab Labels:** Approx. **14px**, Weight **Medium (500)**.
*   **Row Names (e.g., "Windows (C:)"):** Approx. **14px - 15px**, Weight **Medium (500)**.
*   **Row Stats (e.g., "31.32 GB..."):** Approx. **12px - 13px**, Weight **Regular (400)**.
*   **Warning Text:** Approx. **13px**, Weight **Regular (400)**.
*   **Button Text:** Approx. **14px**, Weight **Medium (500)**.
*   **Footer Label:** Approx. **14px**, Weight **Regular (400)**.

### 5) SPACING & SIZING
*   **Dialog Padding:** ~24px - 32px from dialog edge to content.
*   **Icon Size:** 64x64px (Folder graphic).
*   **Tab Height:** ~36px - 40px.
*   **Row Height:** ~70px - 80px (including padding).
*   **Radio Button Diameter:** ~20px.
*   **Drive Icon Size:** 32x32px or 40x40px.
*   **Button Height:** ~36px - 40px.
*   **Button Width:** ~100px - 120px (Save button looks fixed width or auto-padding).
*   **Gutter between Radio and Icon:** ~12px.
*   **Gutter between Icon and Text:** ~12px.
*   **Warning Banner Padding:** ~10px vertical, ~12px horizontal.
*   **Border Radius (Dialog):** ~8px.
*   **Border Radius (Tabs/Button):** ~4px - 6px.

### 6) CONTROLS & STATES
*   **Close Button (Top Right):** State: Normal (Hover/Click implied capability). Icon: 'X'.
*   **Tab Control:**
    *   **"Local" Tab:** State: **Selected/Active**. Visuals: White bg, text black/dark gray.
    *   **"Cloud" Tab:** State: **Normal/Inactive**. Visuals: Transparent/Light gray bg, text gray.
*   **Radio Buttons (Selection):**
    *   **Row 1 (C:):** State: **Checked/Selected**. Visuals: Blue fill, white dot.
    *   **Row 2 (D:):** State: **Unchecked**. Visuals: Empty circle, gray border.
    *   **Row 3 (Choose folder):** State: **Unchecked**. Visuals: Empty circle, gray border.
*   **Warning Icons (Triangle !):**
    *   **Row 1:** Red Warning (Critical/Insufficient Space context).
    *   **Row 2:** Amber/Yellow Warning (Low Space context).
*   **Toggle Switch ("Enable file repair"):** State: **ON/Active**. Visuals: Track is blue, knob is right-aligned.
*   **"Save" Button:** State: **Enabled/Normal**. Visuals: Solid blue background, white text, no visible disable opacity.

### 7) ICONOGRAPHY
*   **Style:** Fluent Design / Modern Windows (Segoe Fluent Icons).
*   **Header Folder:** Filled style, Isometric/Perspective view, Gradient Blue (`#1890ff` to `#096dd9`).
*   **Drive Icons:**
    *   **C::** HDD/SSD icon (gray rectangle with details), overlaid with small Windows logo (4 squares).
    *   **D::** HDD/SSD icon (gray rectangle).
    *   **Choose Folder:** Standard yellow/gold folder icon (filled).
*   **Radio Buttons:** Standard circular radio control.
*   **Warning Icons:** Triangle outline with exclamation mark inside.
*   **Toggle:** Pill-shaped track with circular thumb.

### 8) STATE
*   **Page Level State:** **Partial / Selection Required**.
    *   The user has completed a scan (background shows "Scan Completed").
    *   The user is currently in the "Destination Selection" phase of the recovery workflow.
    *   **Gate/Validation Logic Visible:**
        *   **Insufficient Space Gate:** The destination drive "Windows (C:)" has **31.32 GB free** but requires **146.41 GB**. This triggers the **Red Warning** and the **Yellow Recommendation Banner** ("We highly recommend saving...").
        *   **Retention/Upsell:** The "Enable file repair" toggle is present (likely a premium feature or processing option).
        *   **Actionability:** The "Save" button is **Enabled**, despite the warnings. The application allows the user to proceed (likely to fail later or save partial data), though it strongly advises against it via UI cues.
